messages:
Sasha Lin: Quick heads-up — Nimbus renewal next week. They asked for a short ops pack: 60d uptime, p95 trend, RCA for the March tail, and whether they qualify for credits. Also include onboarding status and any enablement gaps we should surface. @Diego can you pull telemetry? @Priia please check onboarding checklist. Need a 1-page summary by EOD tomorrow.

Diego Morales: Pulling data now. 60d headline: uptime 99.93%, p50 ~72ms, p95 ~285ms. There was a tail event on 2026-03-12 at ~02:10 UTC. Export link: https://redwood.internal/metrics/nimbus/2033456789

Priya Kapoor: Onboarding update: Nimbus has completed 3 of 5 enablement sessions. Remaining: "production tuning" and "alerting/playbooks" — scheduled but not yet delivered. They flagged internal SRE bandwidth as a blocker for doing the playbook run-through.

Ben Torres: Contract SLOs: monthly uptime 99.8% (lenient), p95 <=250ms. Credit rule: credits issued when >1% of minutes breach p95 for the billing month. Diegos numbers show ~1.6% of minutes over threshold in March, so they meet the credit trigger. I'll run the dollar calc and confirm wording.

Diego Morales: CSV snippet:
```
date,p50_ms,p95_ms,minutes_over_p95_pct,uptime_pct
2026-02-01,70,210,0.1,99.99
2026-03-12,74,340,2.4,99.85
2026-03-31,71,260,1.2,99.90
```
Full export uploaded.

Sasha Lin: For the deck we need: (A) 2-sentence customer-facing RCA, (B) the credit amount and exact contract wording, (C) a short onboarding status slide with next steps and owners, (D) a proposed concession if we want to smooth renewal.

Ben Torres: Legal review: since contract threshold met, automatic credit applies. Preliminary calc = prorated 6% invoice credit for March. We can also offer an additional one-time "goodwill" onboarding credit (waive one month of premium onboarding hours) if the customer signs within 14 days. Recommend phrasing the goodwill offer as optional and conditional.

Priya Kapoor: I support the waiver of one onboarding premium hour block as a goodwill gesture. Also propose a focused 90-minute ops workshop to finish the two remaining sessions within 30 days; assignable to Alyssa from CS delivery.

Sasha Lin: Draft RCA for customer slide:
"On 2026-03-12 we observed elevated p95 latency caused by an autoscaler-induced burst of worker restarts that increased request queueing. Immediate mitigation: rolling restart sequencing and temporary scale buffer. Permanent fixes: add sequencing to the autoscale workflow, pre-scale buffer for deploy windows, and an automated tail-latency alert. Patch deployed 2026-03-14."

Ben Torres: I'll finalize the credit dollar amount and draft the customer email. Recommend we present the automatic 6% credit plus the optional onboarding-hours waiver (one-time) as a signing incentive.

Sasha Lin: Perfect. Priya, please coordinate the workshop dates and draft the slide. Diego, attach the final CSV/chart. I'll assemble the one-pager and circulate for sign-off by 5 PM tomorrow.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Nimbus renewal prep review Thursday 11:00 AM PT (invite sent).
